name: Paperform
description: Paperform is an online form builder for creating surveys, quizzes, registrations, lead-capture forms, client onboarding, bookings, payments, and lightweight storefronts. Teams design forms in a document-style editor, add conditional logic and calculations, collect responses and files, manage products and coupons, analyze results, and connect submissions to their wider workflows.
agentUseSummary: Create a dedicated Paperform API key on an eligible paid plan, choose the account's API region, add both once, then decide which agents can read or manage the connected account's authorized forms, fields, submissions, commerce settings, webhooks, spaces, translations, and file links under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.label: Paperform API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated API key on the Paperform account page. Standard API access requires Pro or above, some operations require Business or Enterprise, and Relay encrypts the key.

credentialRequirements.label: Account region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Choose US for ordinary accounts. Choose AU or EU only when Paperform has placed an Enterprise account in that data region.

capabilities.label: Read forms and results
capabilities.description: Use all 22 pinned semantic reads for forms, fields, submissions, partial submissions, products, coupons, webhooks, spaces, translations, and file links.

capabilities.label: Manage forms and workflows
capabilities.description: Use all 22 pinned mutations to update forms and fields; delete submissions; and manage products, coupons, webhooks, spaces, and translations.

allowed.label: Read Paperform
allowed.description: Run one exact selected semantic read from the public Paperform API.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Paperform
approvalRequired.description: Run one exact selected Paperform mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All 22 semantic reads run directly; every mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 44 selected and API-key-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval. Paperform plan entitlements still limit the 25 Standard and 19 Business operations, while connection ownership, fixed-region routing, bounds, audits, redaction, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts all 44 pinned Paperform operations through the encrypted customer-key connector and the selected fixed account region.
Railway mounts all 44 pinned Paperform operations through the encrypted customer-key connector and the selected fixed account region.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned paid Paperform account, dedicated API key, fixed account region, or representative forms and submissions are available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Paperform user on an eligible paid plan creates a dedicated API key, saves the key and correct US, AU, or EU region through Relay Console, then verifies plan entitlements, all 44 operations, semantic Safe reads, Safe approvals, Dangerous mutations, agent assignment, credential replacement, disconnect, key revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Paperform's official API guide documents Bearer API-key authentication, key creation on the account page, Standard and Business API tiers, fixed US, AU, and EU API origins, and rate-limit behavior.
